lines.text: I'm scratching my head over this puzzle.

data.define: Used when you can't figure something out.

example.text: I'm scratching my head over this puzzle.

misuse.text: Don't say 'scratching my head' about an itchy scalp.

publish.title: What does "scratching my head" mean?
publish.value: Scratching my head = I'm confused and thinking hard. Example: "I'm scratching my head over this puzzle." (casual English).
